name: Free Cozy Winter 3D Starter Pack (KernModels)
summary: 8 hand-modeled low-poly winter props in two styles: 4 Classic Stud (snowman, gift box, pine tree, campfire) and 4 Stylized (ice crystal, winter lamp, wooden sled, candy cane), 560-1,368 tris each, clean quads. FBX (pre-scaled for Roblox Studio) and GLB for Unity, Godot, Unreal, Three.js and Blender, plus standalone seamless PBR maps. Useful for holiday updates and winter game scenes.

access.license: KernModels asset license (stated on itch page)
access.notes: Free for personal and commercial games/projects; credit appreciated, not required; do not redistribute or resell the raw asset pack. Page states no generative AI used.

procedure: Click Download Now, enter $0 or any amount, then 'No thanks, just take me to the downloads'
Import the GLB (or the Roblox-scaled FBX) into your engine

verdict.why: Small but genuinely free, commercial-OK, cleanly specified multi-engine pack (GLB+FBX+PBR maps) from the creator; useful seasonal props. Limited count.

image.alt: Render of the 8 props: blocky snowman, layered pine tree, gift box, campfire, ice crystals, winter lamp, sled and candy cane
